```{r setup}
library(GimmmeMySC)
library(Seurat)

project <- "KO"
data()

pal_discrete_sc <- palette_discrete()[-7]
# pal_discrete_sc <- palette_continuous()(length(levels(Idents(seurat))))

assay <- "RNA"

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)
source(file.path(path, "conf.R"))

path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "qc_cluster")
```

## Load data
```{r data}
load("C:/Users/etien/bin/GimmmeMySC/inst/extdata/ko_bcell_cycle.rda")
seurat[["percent_ribosomal"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat, pattern = "^((RP[LS])|(Rp[ls]))")
```

## Clustering
```{r, clus_int_res}
best_resolution <- 0.35
snn_cluster <- paste0(
    assay,
    "_snn_res.",
    best_resolution
)

Idents(seurat) <- seurat[[]][, snn_cluster]

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>%
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cell_cluster.png"))

plot_bar_sc(seurat)
```

```{r, fig.height = 2, fig.width = 2}
plot_dim(seurat, cols = pal_discrete_sc, alpha = .1, label.size = 8) + 
    NoLegend() +
    theme(
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank()
    )
```

```{r}
p2 <- plot_dim(seurat, cols = pal_discrete_sc)
p2

p2 + p1

plot_dim(
    seurat,
    split.by = snn_cluster,
    cols = pal_discrete_sc,
    label = FALSE,
    ncol = 4
) + NoLegend()

plot_ident_celltype(seurat)

heatmap_celltype(seurat, snn_cluster, as_percent = FALSE)
heatmap_celltype(seurat, snn_cluster)
heatmap_celltype(seurat, snn_cluster, margin = 2)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    split.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
    cols = pal_discrete_sc,
    ncol = 3,
    combine = FALSE
)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    split.by = "cell_type_formatted",
    ncol = 3
)
```

## Condition effect
```{r}
seurat_subset <- subsampling_sc(seurat)

plot_dim(
  object = seurat_subset,
  group.by = split.by,
  col = pal_discrete_sc
) + NoLegend()

bar_ident_group(
  seurat_subset,
  idents = snn_cluster
)

bar_group_ident(
  seurat_subset,
  idents = snn_cluster,
  colour = pal_discrete_sc
)
```

## QC
```{r, message = FALSE}
plot_sc_violin(
    seurat,
    nrow = 2,
    ncol = 2,
    normalize = c(10, 10, 10, 10)
)
```

## Annotation
```{r, eval = FALSE, fig.height = 12}
singleR_fine <- readRDS(file.path(path, "singleR_fin_bcell.rds"))
for (x in unique(Idents(seurat)))
  plotScoreHeatmap(
    singleR_fine,
    labels.use = unique(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted),
    # annotation_legend = FALSE,
    cells.use = WhichCells(seurat, idents = x),
    color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))(100),
    # normalize = FALSE,
    max.labels = 10,
    # show.pruned = TRUE
  )
```
